controls.label: "Use this image"
controls.onClick: {() => { if (busy || jobRunning || appliedDraftKey === `${draftPreviewKey}:${destination}`) return; prepareFocus.current = showAdjustments ? "use-static" : "use-artwork"; if (draftPreviewKey && job?.state === "ready" && job.mode && draftPreviewKey === job.prepared?.sha256) { void activatePrepared(selectedGame.appid, job.mode, job.prepared); } else void prepare(true); }}

controls.label: {destination === "game" || destination === "game-dashboard" ? "Apply to this game" : destination === "home" ? "Apply to Dashboard Home" : "Apply to both"}
controls.onClick: {() => !busy && !jobRunning && appliedDraftKey !== `${draftPreviewKey}:${destination}` && job.mode && selectedGame && void activatePrepared(selectedGame.appid, job.mode, job.prepared)}

controls.label: "Cancel preparation"
controls.onClick: {() => { activateWhenReady.current = null; void cancelFaceplateArtwork().then((next) => setArtworkState((previous) => ({ job: next, selected: previous?.selected ?? {}, prepared: previous?.prepared ?? {}, }))).finally(() => restoreArtworkFocus("use-artwork")); }}

controls.label: {previewTarget === "artwork" ? "Preview Artwork in-game" : previewTarget === "dashboard" ? "Preview Artwork Dashboard" : "Preview Weather Dashboard"}
controls.onClick: {() => { if (previewTarget === "artwork") { setNativePreviewBusy(true); void getFaceplateArtworkPreview(selectedGame.appid) .then((value) => { setNativePreview(value.data_uri); setMessage(value.error ? value.error : ""); }) .catch((error) => setMessage(`Preview failed: ${String(error)}`)) .finally(() => { setNativePreviewBusy(false); restoreArtworkFocus("result-preview"); }); } else if (previewTarget === "dashboard") { setDashboardPreviewBusy(true); void getFaceplateArtworkDashboardPreview(selectedGame.appid, "", false, useForDashboardHome) .then((value) => { setDashboardPreview(value.data_uri); setMessage(""); }) .catch((error) => setMessage(`Preview failed: ${String(error)}`)) .finally(() => { setDashboardPreviewBusy(false); restoreArtworkFocus("result-preview"); }); } else { setDashboardPreviewBusy(true); void getFaceplateDashboardPreview(weatherDashboardCondition, weatherDashboardVariant, "weather-artwork-v2") .then((value) => { setWeatherDashboardPreview(value.data_uri); setMessage(value.error ? `Preview failed: ${value.error}` : ""); }) .catch((error) => setMessage(`Preview failed: ${String(error)}`)) .finally(() => { setDashboardPreviewBusy(false); restoreArtworkFocus("result-preview"); }); } }}

controls.label: "Faceplate image projection"

controls.label: "Artwork image"
controls.onChange: {async (option) => { const next = await setSetting("launch_artwork_source", String(option.data)); setStatus(next); if (next.game.appid > 0) await loadAndSampleArtwork(next.game.appid, next.launch_artwork_source, "launch"); }}

controls.label: {`Launch colour ${index + 1}`}
controls.onChange: {(nextColor) => { const palettes = { "2": status.launch_artwork_custom_palettes["2"].map((entry) => [...entry] as RGB) as [ RGB, RGB ], "3": status.launch_artwork_custom_palettes["3"].map((entry) => [...entry] as RGB) as [ RGB, RGB, RGB ], }; palettes[String(status.launch_artwork_colour_count) as "2" | "3"][index] = nextColor; void setLaunchArtworkSetting(status.game.appid, "custom_palettes", palettes).then(setStatus).catch(console.warn); }}

controls.label: "Dashboard at Home"
controls.onChange: {async (option) => { const source = option.data as "weather" | "artwork"; if (source === "artwork" && status.faceplate_dashboard_home_appid <= 0) { setFaceplateRoutingMessage("No Artwork Dashboard is assigned yet. Open Faceplate Artwork Studio, choose a saved artwork, then select Use for Dashboard Home."); return; } try { setStatus(await setSetting("faceplate_dashboard_home_source", source)); setFaceplateRoutingMessage(source === "weather" ? "Weather Dashboard selected. Your Artwork Dashboard assignment is kept for later." : "Artwork Dashboard selected."); } catch (error) { setFaceplateRoutingMessage(String(error).replace(/^Error:\s*/, "")); } }}
